# Extract the "End of period" balance values (in millions) for July-January
# From the tables in each bulletin

# FY 1962-63 (from 1963-02 bulletin, Table 2)
fy62_63 = [5528, 4637, 4770, 7342, 3841, 5374, 4206]

# FY 1963-64 (from 1964-02 bulletin, Table 2)

# FY 1964-65 (from 1965-02 bulletin, Table 2)
fy64_65 = [6519, 4514, 4880, 6434, 3394, 6699, 4198]

def compute_stats(balances):
    max_val = max(balances)
    min_val = min(balances)
    range_val = max_val - min_val
    avg_val = sum(balances) / len(balances)
    pct = (range_val / avg_val) * 100
    return range_val, avg_val, pct

stats_62_63 = compute_stats(fy62_63)
stats_63_64 = compute_stats(fy63_64)
stats_64_65 = compute_stats(fy64_65)

print("FY 1962-63 balances:", fy62_63)
